content_blocks.content:
Alt+F2 -> Performance Profiler
- CPU Usage (sampling/instrumentation)
- Memory Usage (snapshots, diff)
- .NET Object Allocation Tracking
- Database (EF Core queries)
dotnet-counters — runtime метрики в реальном времени

dotnet tool install -g dotnet-counters
dotnet counters monitor --process-id <PID> --counters System.Runtime
3. JIT, Tiered Compilation, ReadyToRun, Native AOT

<!-- .csproj -->
<PropertyGroup>
  <PublishReadyToRun>true</PublishReadyToRun>
  <!-- Для cross-platform: -->
  <PublishReadyToRunComposite>true</PublishReadyToRunComposite>
</PropertyGroup>

<!-- Публикация -->
dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained

<!-- .csproj -->
<PropertyGroup>
  <PublishAot>true</PublishAot>
  <StripSymbols>true</StripSymbols>
  <InvariantGlobalization>true</InvariantGlobalization>
</PropertyGroup>

<!-- Ограничения AOT:
- Нет Reflection.Emit
- Нет dynamic
- Ограниченная рефлексия (требует [DynamicallyAccessedMembers])
- Нет Assembly.LoadFromAssembly
-->
